text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then.
Once upon a time, a great person said:"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
When nothing bites, it means
the fish are giving you time to think.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Those are nice words~. And so, Sei-chan
gave it a lot of thought too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Changing locations. Changing equipment.
It was truly delightful to come up with all sorts of setups.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. Still, it feels kinda lonely
when not a single one takes the bait~."
